title: Will McDonald asks the Jets for a trade

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Will McDonald asks the Jets for a trade
sources.description: The NFL Trade Deadline is Tuesday afternoon at 4:00 pm Eastern. A year ago the Jets were perhaps the most active team at the deadline, sending Sauce Gardner to the Colts and Quinnen Williams to the Cowboys for a bounty of picks. The deals have a chance to transform the franchise for years to come […]
